notes.title: New version
notes.content:
- Added achievements
- Updated Unity from [b]2018 [/b]to [b]2021[/b]
- Added back button to game Lobby
- Added current build version to game menu
- Added better visual text effect when running out of time
- Added better visual text effect for active traps
- Added flicker effect for lights 
- Numerous bug fixes
- Improved characters visual placement sidebar
- Increased speech sound volume.
